title: Inhibition of SARS-CoV-2 replication by a ssDNA aptamer targeting the nucleocapsid protein.
authors: Huang, Yanping; Huang, Congcong; Chen, Junkai; Chen, Siwei; Li, Bei; Li, Jian; Jin, Zhixiong; Zhang, Qiwei; Pan, Pan; Du, Weixing; Liu, Long; Liu, Zhixin
one_liner_zh: 该研究开发靶向SARS-CoV-2核衣壳蛋白的DNA适配体，通过破坏N蛋白的液-液相分离来抑制病毒复制，涉及IDR介导的LLPS互作机制，但方法为实验表征而非AI/物理模拟建模。
abstract: The nucleocapsid protein of SARS-CoV-2 plays significant roles in viral assembly, immune evasion, and viral stability. Due to its immunogenicity, high expression levels during COVID-19, and conservation across viral strains, it represents an attractive target for antiviral treatment. In this study, we identified and characterized a single-stranded DNA aptamer, N-Apt17, which effectively disrupts the liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) mediated by the N protein. To enhance the aptamer's stability, a circular bivalent form, cb-N-Apt17, was designed and evaluated. Our findings demonstrated that cb-N-Apt17 exhibited improved stability, enhanced binding affinity, and superior inhibition of N protein LLPS; thus, it has the potential inhibition ability on viral replication. These results provide valuable evidence supporting the potential of cb-N-Apt17 as a promising candidate for the development of antiviral therapies against COVID-19.IMPORTANCEVariants of SARS-CoV-2 pose a significant challenge to currently available COVID-19 vaccines and therapies due to the rapid epitope changes observed in the viral spike protein. However, the nucleocapsid (N) protein of SARS-CoV-2, a highly conserved structural protein, offers promising potential as a target for inhibiting viral replication. The N protein forms complexes with genomic RNA, interacts with other viral structural proteins during virion assembly, and plays a critical role in evading host innate immunity by impairing interferon production during viral infection. In this investigation, we discovered a single-stranded DNA aptamer, designated as N-Apt17, exhibiting remarkable affinity and specificity for the N protein. Notably, N-Apt17 disrupts the liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) of the N protein. To enhance the stability and molecular recognition capabilities of N-Apt17, we designed a circular bivalent DNA aptamer termed cb-N-Apt17. In both in vivo and in vitro experiments, cb-N-Apt17 exhibited increased stability, enhanced binding affinity, and superior LLPS disrupting ability. Thus, our study provides essential proof-of-principle evidence supporting the further development of cb-N-Apt17 as a therapeutic candidate for COVID-19.
abstract_zh:
SARS-CoV-2的核衣壳蛋白在病毒组装、免疫逃逸和病毒稳定性中发挥重要作用。由于其免疫原性、在COVID-19期间的高表达水平以及跨病毒株的保守性，它代表了抗病毒治疗的一个有吸引力的靶点。在本研究中，我们鉴定并表征了一种单链DNA适配体N-Apt17，它能有效破坏由N蛋白介导的液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation, LLPS）。为增强适配体的稳定性，设计并评估了一种环状二价形式cb-N-Apt17。我们的研究结果表明，cb-N-Apt17表现出改善的稳定性、增强的结合亲和力以及对N蛋白LLPS的优越抑制能力；因此，它具有抑制病毒复制的潜在能力。这些结果提供了有价值的证据，支持cb-N-Apt17作为开发针对COVID-19抗病毒疗法的有前景候选物的潜力。

重要性SARS-CoV-2的变异株对目前可用的COVID-19疫苗和疗法构成重大挑战，这是因为在病毒刺突蛋白中观察到的快速表位变化。然而，SARS-CoV-2的核衣壳（N）蛋白作为一种高度保守的结构蛋白，为抑制病毒复制提供了有前景的靶点潜力。N蛋白与基因组RNA形成复合物，在病毒粒子组装过程中与其他病毒结构蛋白相互作用，并在病毒感染期间通过损害干扰素产生而在逃逸宿主先天免疫中发挥关键作用。在本研究中，我们发现了一种单链DNA适配体，命名为N-Apt17，它对N蛋白表现出显著的亲和力和特异性。值得注意的是，N-Apt17破坏了N蛋白的液-液相分离（LLPS）。为增强N-Apt17的稳定性和分子识别能力，我们设计了一种环状二价DNA适配体，称为cb-N-Apt17。在体内和体外实验中，cb-N-Apt17均表现出增加的稳定性、增强的结合亲和力以及优越的LLPS破坏能力。因此，我们的研究提供了必要的原理验证证据，支持cb-N-Apt17作为COVID-19治疗候选物的进一步开发。
